title: Copilot memory in Researcher removed from the roadmap
summary: Microsoft 365 Roadmap item 562996, Copilot memory in Researcher, was set to 'Cancelled' on 26 November 2026 with a note that it 'is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap'. The item had promised that Researcher would bring forward context from a user's past interactions. Microsoft gives no reason and no replacement date; the separate item for memory in Word, Excel and PowerPoint (580889) is unaffected by this change.
why: If your AI governance review or user guidance assumed Researcher would use memory, update it. It also shows that roadmap AI features can disappear without a Message Center post.
todo: Remove Researcher memory from internal Copilot roadmaps and training material.
Keep your review of Copilot memory in Office apps (580889) on track; that item still stands.
Treat 'In development' AI roadmap items as plans, not commitments, in change planning.
effective_note: Roadmap 562996 status Cancelled (modified 26 Nov 2026). Reason not stated.
